newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-CANTERBURY EASY WINNERS IN NZ'S SHELL CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CANTERBURY EASY WINNERS IN NZ'S SHELL CUP.

text.p: Canterbury cruised to a 123-run victory in the final of New Zealand's one-day Shell Cup competition on Wednesday, skittling out Wellington for just 81 runs.
Canterbury, who have dominated the competition in recent years, scored 204 for seven from their 50 overs, with test all-rounder Chris Cairns top-scoring on 42.
Wellington were never in the hunt, losing their first four wickets for just nine runs. Roger Twose was the only batsman to offer resistance, scoring 24 before being caught behind off Cairns.
Cairns took two wickets in Wellington's innings, which ended in the 34th over, and Mark Priest captured three for 15 to follow up his innings of 35 not out.
Canterbury have now won five of the last six finals.
